subject: Onramp playlist: environment standup, MAP items, and timeline
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Sam Torres <sam.torres@novadocs.com>, Lisa Nguyen <lisa.nguyen@novadocs.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Sep 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Onramp playlist: environment standup, MAP items, and timeline

Sam / Lisa —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick follow-up with a pragmatic onramp playlist so we can land the POC environment and close to pilot within the next 3 weeks. This is the MAP-level checklist I promised — short, owner-oriented, and sequencing-friendly.

High-level asks (we can trim if you prefer):
- Org & accounts: create the NovaDocs Redwood org admin account (we'll provide the invite link) — owner: NovaDocs IT (Lisa) — due: Sep 19
- API keys: Redwood provides scoped API keys for evaluation; we’ll issue keys for staging (non-prod) and a read-only telemetry key — owner: Naomi/Redwood — due: Sep 18
- IP allowlist: whitelist these egress blocks for token calls and telemetry (template attached) — owner: NovaDocs infra (Sam) — due: Sep 20
- VPC peering: optional but recommended for throughput-sensitive tests; guidance attached (peering playbook) — owner: NovaDocs infra & network — kickoff: Sep 22 (if you opt in)
- Validation window: 10 full business days of traffic tests once environment is up — target window: Sep 23–Oct 6

I attached a one-page MAP_onramp_checklist and a CSV allowlist template to make the steps copy/paste friendly. Proposed sequencing (short):
1) Sep 18: Redwood issues API keys and invite link to org admin.
2) Sep 19–20: NovaDocs completes org setup + allowlist.
3) Sep 21: Redwood smoke test (connectivity + basic inference).
4) Sep 22–Oct 6: Evaluation window, optional peering cutover on Sep 24 if agreed.

Can you confirm the owners and whether you want the VPC peering included in the first pass? If you prefer we trim the first week to just API keys + allowlist, we can do that and push peering to a follow-up sprint.

Thanks — I’ll queue the DocuSign for the evaluation addendum once you confirm the timeline.

—
Naomi Feldman
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: MAP_onramp_checklist.pdf (1 page), allowlist_template.csv (CSV), vpc-peering-playbook.md (5 pages)
From: Sam Torres <sam.torres@novadocs.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Nguyen <lisa.nguyen@novadocs.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Sep 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onramp playlist: environment standup, MAP items, and timeline

Naomi —

Appreciate the clear checklist. Quick questions from infra:
1) For the API keys, do you need a dedicated service account from our side, or will Redwood issue keys that we can rotate on our schedule?
2) The allowlist template — are those egress CIDR blocks for outbound requests to Redwood hosted endpoints, or also for telemetry callbacks?
3) VPC peering: our infra lead is cautious about opening peering before we've validated token flows. Can we do peering as a second sprint (after Sep 24) and do a temporary NAT-based route for the first week?

Owners: I can own the allowlist and staging NAT route. Lisa will own the org admin creation.

Sam
Sam Torres
Infra Lead, NovaDocs
sam.torres@novadocs.com
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Sam Torres <sam.torres@novadocs.com>, Lisa Nguyen <lisa.nguyen@novadocs.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Sep 2025 13:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onramp playlist: environment standup, MAP items, and timeline

Thanks Sam — good clarifying questions. Short answers and a couple of small adjustments to the MAP below.

1) API keys: Redwood will issue scoped keys for the evaluation. Keys are bearer tokens issued to the Redwood org admin invite and can be rotated by NovaDocs via our console once a dedicated admin user is confirmed. We will include a telemetry-only key (read-only) and a staging inference key.

2) Allowlist: the CSV template lists egress CIDRs for both inference endpoints and telemetry ingestion. I annotated the two columns in the template as INFERENCE/TELEMETRY so you can apply them to separate firewall rules.

3) Peering: absolutely fine to push peering to Sprint 2. For Sprint 1 we recommend the NAT route approach as you suggested. If you go that route, please add 10.8.0.0/22 to the temp NAT rules — that’s our outgoing NAT block for rapid evals.

Updated sequencing (minimal first pass):
- Sep 18: Redwood publishes API keys, sends invite link to org admin.
- Sep 19: NovaDocs org admin created and confirmed (Lisa).
- Sep 20: Allowlist + NAT route applied (Sam).
- Sep 21: Redwood runs smoke tests against staging keys; we’ll share logs and failure items.
- Sep 22–Oct 3: Evaluation window (10 business days adjusted one-day shift)
- Sep 26–29: Optional peering planning meeting if you want early cutover planning (Sprint 2).

I attached the peering playbook if you want to skim it; the doc has the minimal required BGP info and tagging patterns.

Next steps: Lisa — can you create the org admin and reply with the admin email we should invite? Sam — please confirm you can apply the NAT block above by EOD Sep 19 and whether you need any ASN info from our side for the peering docs.

If that all looks good I’ll prepare the evaluation addendum and send a DocuSign link (one-click sign for the addendum).

—
Naomi Feldman
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: vpc-peering-playbook.md, MAP_onramp_checklist.pdf
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Sam Torres <sam.torres@novadocs.com>, Lisa Nguyen <lisa.nguyen@novadocs.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Sep 2025 15:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onramp playlist: environment standup, MAP items, and timeline

Looping in a short note from ops perspective — thanks for drafting this, Naomi. Two operational confirmations:
- We'll tag the staging keys with the deal_id (RWF-3421) so cost and latency stats are isolated in the Console.
- We'll enable token-level tracing for the smoke test day (Sep 21) and share a short trace bundle with NovaDocs for triage.

Naomi — Jonas and I will join the Sep 26 peering planning meeting if it happens.

Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Reliability | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com
From: Lisa Nguyen <lisa.nguyen@novadocs.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Sam Torres <sam.torres@novadocs.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Sep 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onramp playlist: environment standup, MAP items, and timeline

Naomi / Sam —

I created the NovaDocs evaluation admin (eval-admin@novadocs.com) and set MFA. Please go ahead and send the invite and keys to that address. Sam has confirmed he can apply the NAT block by EOD Sep 19.

We are good to proceed on the minimal first pass approach. Please send the DocuSign for the evaluation addendum when ready and a short checklist of what we should expect during the smoke test.

Thanks,
Lisa Nguyen
IT Manager, NovaDocs
lisa.nguyen@novadocs.com
